scope: Loop06: three exact remotely operated sewer-inspection camera/crawler configurations, German manufacturer buying routes, configuration-dependent limits and conservative task evidence.

records.name: IBAK T76 HD + ORPHEUS 3 HD
records.exactConfiguration: T76 HD crawler with ORPHEUS 3 HD pan-and-tilt camera. Compatible HD reel, control unit, wheels and reporting software must be specified in the quotation.
records.description: A cable-connected sewer camera crawler for an inspector to drive and record pipe interiors from DN150. The camera is a measuring and recording tool; acceptance decisions remain with the inspection team.

operatingMode.value: Human-operated crawler and camera; powered steering, focus and inspection-assistance features.
caveats: A surface operator controls the inspection. No unattended inspection or automatic acceptance is established.
Launching, cable management, wheel selection and recovery require a site procedure.

conditions: DN150; access, wheels, water level and geometry still constrain passage.
Camera component only; not the crawler envelope.
HD column; the SD camera is 160mm and is not substituted.
Optical magnification; optional digital zoom is a separate feature.
Camera specification; not a validated minimum defect-detection distance.
ORPHEUS 3 HD; requires compatible HD system components.
No job-specific measurement accuracy was established.
Current assembled weight with selected wheels and accessories has not been confirmed.

taskEvidence.task: Capture sewer interior imagery and camera-assisted measurements from a remotely driven crawler.
taskEvidence.configuration: ORPHEUS 3 HD with compatible T76 HD as listed in the camera brochure.
taskEvidence.operatingMode: Inspector drives the crawler and operates the pan-and-tilt camera from the surface.
limitations: No independent defect-detection denominator, repeatability result or metres-per-shift measurement reviewed.
The April2026 GMB delivery names T76 and ORPHEUS3 with HD-SDI, but omits exact HD suffixes; it supports current family supply, not proof that this precise quoted configuration completed routine work.
The complete acceptance workflow includes cleaning/visibility preparation, coded findings, report review and contractual acceptance.

buyingRoutes.organization: IBAK Helmut Hunger GmbH & Co. KG
buyingRoutes.deliveryStatus: Product advice and quotations are published; exact HD configuration, lead time and stock require confirmation.
caveats: Select the German region and inspection-systems contact.
Ask for current camera generation, compatibility, software licence, training and service coverage.

conflicts: Older brochures distinguish ORPHEUS3 SD and ORPHEUS3 HD. The 2026 delivery article uses ORPHEUS3 without the HD suffix while describing HD-SDI; these names must be reconciled on the quote.
Explosion-protection features are component/configuration-specific; a brochure flag is not confirmation that the complete quoted system is approved for a particular site.
unknowns: Current exact bill of materials and full configured dimensions/mass.
Inspection speed, missed-defect rate, repeatability and operator intervention frequency in the user's pipes.
Current exact-model product photograph was not resolved; use the explicit class illustration fallback.

records.name: iPEK ROVION RX130 + RCX90X HD
records.exactConfiguration: ROVION RX130 crawler with RCX90X HD pan-and-tilt camera. RAX300 is a published reel option; the compatible HD controller, cable, wheels and lift must be confirmed in an itemised quotation.
records.description: A steerable sewer crawler with a separate pan-and-tilt camera and surface controller. The inspector drives, logs observations and prepares the inspection report.

operatingMode.value: Human-operated via joysticks and touchscreen; powered crawler, camera and cable reel.
caveats: Human control and defect coding remain part of the published workflow.
Automatic focus and reporting tools do not establish autonomous inspection or validated automatic defect classification.

conditions: RX130, not smaller RX95; passage depends on camera/wheel configuration.

specs.semanticLabel: RX130 base range upper diameter in English configurator
conditions: Configurator separates a150–300mm base range from optional extensions.

specs.semanticLabel: RX130 stated upper range with options
conditions: Correct lifts, wheels and accessories are required; not the base configuration.
Published RAX300 reel option; installed cable length and HD compatibility must be quoted. Cable capacity is not guaranteed inspection distance through obstructions.
Camera alone; does not expand the RX130 crawler's150mm minimum or optional1000mm upper range.
Operator still chooses views and evaluates images.
Measurement accuracy/calibration limits were not reviewed.

specs.semanticLabel: RX130 rear-view camera listed in configurator
conditions: Confirm included version in the quote.

taskEvidence.task: Drive a mainline sewer inspection, record imagery and manually code observations for a report.
taskEvidence.configuration: ROVION mainline system with RX130 and RCX90X HD selected from the official component range.
taskEvidence.operatingMode: Operator uses separate crawler/camera joysticks, touchscreen annotations and reporting tools.
limitations: No exact-configuration customer production study or independent missed-defect benchmark reviewed.
Camera range, general ROVION family range and RX130 crawler range are different limits.
Manhole access, cable traction, water visibility and configuration compatibility require a site-specific review.

buyingRoutes.deliveryStatus: The German page advertises ready inspection vehicles. No dated stock allocation or lead time for this exact component set was confirmed.
buyingRoutes.authorizationStatus: Manufacturer's own enquiry page and German business contact.
caveats: The advertised vehicle package includes several camera/crawler choices; request the exact RX130/RCX90X HD/controller/reel combination.
Confirm software licence, German reporting templates, training and service terms.

conflicts: The mainline overview gives RX130 DN150–1000, while the English configurator clarifies150–300mm plus options to1000mm; both are retained with their conditions.
Product pages also display RX130L and newer RCX100HD; their lift, dimensional and performance claims are not transferred to RX130/RCX90X HD.
unknowns: As-configured crawler mass, envelope, cable pulling limits and current controller compatibility.
A live German stock position and guaranteed delivery date for the exact set.
Quantified inspection completeness, productivity and intervention rates.

records.name: Rausch FW135 + KS135 HD
records.exactConfiguration: FW135 crawler with KS135 HD camera in an RCA5.0/Rausch Premium surface-control system. Required wheel sets, reel and optional large-pipe carrier are selected separately.
records.description: A remotely operated mainline sewer crawler with electric camera lift and HD pan-and-tilt imaging. It supports inspection capture and measurements while an inspector controls the work and interprets findings.

operatingMode.value: Human-operated with two multifunction joysticks; assisted steering and automatic reverse functions.
caveats: Automatic steering/reverse are motion assistance, not autonomous inspection or defect acceptance.
The operator manages launch, cable, view selection and reporting.

conditions: Basic application range; electric lift/rear-view accessories have separate150mm conditions.

specs.semanticLabel: FW135 published upper range without Lafette extension
conditions: Appropriate wheel/height accessories still required; not one fixed setup for the entire range.

specs.semanticLabel: FW135 upper pipe range with Lafette carrier
conditions: Optional carrier configuration, not supplied-base crawler capability.
HD camera/system; the separate SD TV-line figure is not used as the HD resolution.
Digital12x zoom is separately listed and does not add optical detail.
No task-specific precision tolerance established.
Camera motion only; not crawler travel speed or inspection throughput.
Accessory section lists stepless positioning from150mm pipe diameter.

taskEvidence.task: Inspect mainline pipe interiors with remotely driven HD video capture and camera-assisted measurements.
taskEvidence.configuration: FW135 with KS135 HD in the published mainline combination; RCA5.0 surface control.
taskEvidence.operatingMode: Inspector controls crawler and camera; assisted reverse/steering and focus functions.
limitations: A named customer quotation on the product page discusses image quality but supplies no exact-configuration operating denominator or measured defect rate.
This configuration does not include the separate M-Series lateral-launch modules.
Coded acceptance reporting, inspection completeness and site suitability require competent human review.

buyingRoutes.deliveryStatus: Published German manufacturer sales route; stock, lead time, vehicle fit-out and selected crawler options require a quote.
buyingRoutes.authorizationStatus: Manufacturer's own product page and German sales contact.
caveats: Confirm exact FW135/KS135HD naming and available revision; do not substitute historical L135 figures.
Request installation, reporting software, wheel sets, service and training as itemised scope.

conflicts: Rausch Premium mentions up to500m camera cable in the overview and up to550m for ELKA600 in the reel section. Cable capacity remains quote-dependent and is not treated as guaranteed crawler reach.
Historical L135 data from other regions are not assumed identical to the current German FW135 configuration.
unknowns: Complete configured mass, clearance envelope and verified bend/grade limits.
Inspection productivity, recovery rate and missed-defect rate in the intended pipe conditions.
Current delivery date, complete system price and exact software/licensing scope.
